text_en: Yes! This old dog still has a good nose. How did you think I got around all that venom?

Of course I'm not talking to myself. I'm talking to you, tin man. You know? I've stopped being surprised at you turning up. You have the same adventurous spirit I did at your age. Well... and at mine.
Don't tell me, I'll guess, yes? You're looking for... New maps! Say no more. You'll find everything you need in my shop, yes?
